findings.explanation: 1897 is the deprecated 'Cisco ACI Add-on for Splunk Enterprise' (migrate to 7777) and the cached catalogue calls 4241 the 'VMware NSX-T Splunk App'; neither, nor the VMware add-on 3215, feeds any of the five sourcetypes the SPL reads.
findings.quote: **Splunk Add-on for Cisco ACI** ([Splunkbase 1897](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/1897)); **Splunk Add-on for VMware NSX** ([Splunkbase 4241](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/4241))
findings.suggested_fix: Drop 1897/4241/3215 from app, dataSources and references (or move them to an optional correlation note with correct names).

findings.explanation: VTEP peer state, ping-nve RTT/loss and NVE counters are device/probe health metrics, not network traffic sessions, and the Performance model targets host CPU/memory/storage; the SPL uses neither and the schema text is speculative.
findings.suggested_fix: Set cimModels to [] and remove the schema/dataModelAcceleration rationale.

findings.explanation: detailedImplementation says counters must be compared as deltas, but the SPL sums raw encap_errors/decap_errors per 10-minute bin and flags any value >0; if the polled counters are cumulative, every poll re-adds the lifetime total and counter_breach fires permanently.
findings.quote: Validate **encap_errors** growth in **nxos:nve_counters** against CLI **show nve interface** deltas, not one-shot SNMP absolutes.
findings.suggested_fix: Either state that collectors must emit per-interval deltas, or describe the delta computation the search needs.

findings.explanation: Splunk search macros are invoked with backticks, not percent signs.
findings.suggested_fix: Write the macro reference as `dc_fabric_idx` in backticks.

findings.explanation: UC-18.3.14 is spine-leaf topology/LLDP integrity, not EVPN neighbor state; the real overlaps are UC-18.3.9 (VTEP reachability) and UC-18.3.11 (EVPN/VXLAN tunnel health, which reads the same nve_peers/nve_counters/vxlan_tunnel/syslog lanes) and are not delineated.
findings.quote: Pure EVPN neighbor-state dashboards without NVE counter or RTT lanes (UC-18.3.14)
findings.suggested_fix: Point exclusions at UC-18.3.9 and UC-18.3.11 and state that this UC adds ping-nve RTT/loss.

findings.explanation: The URL is the Cisco.com home page; there is also no reference for the `ping nve` / VXLAN OAM feature the UC depends on.

"title": "Cisco Nexus 9000 NX-OS VXLAN BGP EVPN Configuration Guide",
      "url": "https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/"
findings.suggested_fix: Link the Nexus 9000 VXLAN configuration guide and its VXLAN OAM (ping nve) chapter.

findings.explanation: Verified by an automated reviewer although the SPL drops its core loss/RTT lane.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: `stats ... BY _time leaf fabric_site vni` drops every event whose vni is null, and vni is `tonumber(coalesce(vni,l2vni,bd_vni,""))`, i.e. null whenever no VNI field exists. network:ping_results, interface-level nxos:nve_counters, network:vxlan_tunnel aggregates and cisco:nxos:syslog rows normally lack a VNI, so the loss/RTT/counter/syslog breaches never reach the output; the `if(isnotnull(vni),...,"any")` branch in story is dead code. Fill vni with a sentinel (fillnull value="any" vni) before stats.

nve_peer_down matches 'down|failed|init|unknown' anywhere in the lowercased raw event, so any nxos:nve_peers JSON containing those substrings in any key or value (e.g. a reset-reason or 'unknown' learn-type field) is scored as a peer down (weight 5). Match the state field instead.

summary: Good operational narrative (ping nve probes, CLI validation, failure modes), but the SPL's stats BY vni silently discards the ping, counter, tunnel and syslog lanes that carry the loss/RTT signal, the add-on list repeats mis-named/irrelevant Splunkbase entries, and the CIM mapping does not fit.
